title: Longest Path With Different Adjacent Characters
summary: Given a tree with nodes numbered from 0 to n-1, where each node has a character assigned, find the longest path where no two adjacent nodes have the same character.
statement: Given a tree with nodes numbered from 0 to n-1, where each node has a character assigned, find the longest path where no two adjacent nodes have the same character. The tree is defined by a parent array and a string representing the characters at each node.
constraints: parent describes a rooted tree at node zero and s gives one character per node.
A valid simple path may start and end anywhere, but adjacent path nodes must have different characters.
Return path length measured in nodes.
reference_solution:
def longest_different_adjacent_path(parent,s):
    children=[[] for _ in parent]
    for node in range(1,len(parent)):children[parent[node]].append(node)
    answer=1
    def visit(node):
        nonlocal answer
        first=second=0
        for child in children[node]:
            length=visit(child)
            if s[child]==s[node]:continue
            if length>first:second,first=first,length
            elif length>second:second=length
        answer=max(answer,first+second+1)
        return first+1
    visit(0)
    return answer
